messages:
maria: Heads-up — the mini Next edge SSR sample in samplekit (TS) is crashing on first render for me. Hydration mismatch + server log shows "TypeError: fetch is not a function". Repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit (edge-ssr branch)

jon: Which runtime are you hitting? edge or node?

maria: Edge (Vercel Edge Runtime). Stack trace is short: 
```
TypeError: fetch is not a function
    at /vercel/path0/.vercel_build_output/static/__vc_something__ (pages/index.js:12:7)
    at async Module._compile (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:999:30)
```
Also browser shows "Hydration failed: Text content does not match" immediately.

lee: That looks like the SSR code is importing the browser bundle of the SDK. We recently changed the default export in @redwood/inference to assume global fetch is present. For edge SSR you should import the node/edge server variant, e.g. `import { createServerClient } from '@redwood/inference-node'` or use the explicit edge build.

sara: We actually ship the sample importing `redwood` (the alias resolves to browser bundle) — that's a DX bug in the sample. The README also doesn't mention the env var requirement (REDWOOD_API_KEY) clearly.

maria: Minimal repro (in sample):
```js
// pages/api/generate.ts
import { RedwoodClient } from 'redwood'
export default async function handler(req, res) {
  const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
  const r = await client.generate({ model: 'gpt-4o-mini', input: req.body.text })
  res.json(r)
}
```
This fails on build in edge runtime because the imported bundle expects `window.fetch`.

maria: Quick fix locally: swap import to `@redwood/inference-node` and add REDWOOD_API_KEY to Vercel env. Also adding a tiny server-only wrapper prevents runtime mismatch.

jon: I'll open a small PR to update the sample: replace imports, add .env.example with REDWOOD_API_KEY, and a short note in README about runtime vs browser bundles. Also add a runtime detection note: `if (typeof window === 'undefined')` for server-side.

dev-bot: CI: samplekit build on main failed at 1854321075 — see https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/logs/1234 for logs.

maria: :thumbsup: after swapping imports and setting env the sample builds locally for me and hydration error goes away. Will test on Vercel next.

jon: One more related DX/SDK parity issue: retry/token-refresh behavior. We observed 401 loops in serverless because the retry logic lives in the browser bundle only. Server package doesn't auto-refresh tokens on 401 — needs parity.

lee: Good catch. I'll file an internal ticket to add retry/token-refresh to the server packages and add an E2E test in samples. Assigning to infra/SDK team.

sara: Filed ISSUE: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/issues/789 and assigned to @lee. For immediate patch: sample PR will replace the import, add env notes, and include a brief "SSR gotchas" checklist (runtime, env var, package import, polyfills).

maria: I'll include the checklist and a short repro section in the PR so newcomers can self-diagnose quickly. Thanks everyone.
